data: Is the accuracy of the WN18RR dataset consistently higher than the FB15K-237 dataset for rule body indices less than 4?

The caption states that there are high-quality rules on WN18RR. The graph shows two lines representing the accuracy of the WN18RR and FB15K-237 datasets across different rule body indices. The blue line represents the WN18RR dataset, and the orange line represents the FB15K-237 dataset. The x-axis is labeled "Rule Body Index," and the y-axis is labeled "Accuracy." The graph shows that the WN18RR dataset has higher accuracy than the FB15K-237 dataset for rule body indices less than 4. Therefore, the accuracy of the WN18RR dataset is consistently higher than the FB15K-237 dataset for rule body indices less than 4.
